label: 3. I can't thank you all enough.

lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 106010112 · After Rehabilitation Room chat 2. Rumani,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I can't thank you all enough.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Thanks to all of your combined efforts,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Nadia was able to stand up again.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: No,

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: it was you who did all the hard work, Rumani.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Yeah,

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: you really gave it your all, Rumani!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: The moment Nadia stood up and hugged you,

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I could barely hold back my tears.
I don't see why you're so emotional. It wasn't that bad.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Don't lie,

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Coach.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I saw you with a runny nose.
Don't be ridiculous.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: You should be honest, Coach.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I was on the edge of tears the whole time.
Honestly, I'm actually crying right now.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: All right, let's cry together then :'(

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Would you two stop it?
Okay.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Anyway, good job, Rumani.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Thanks! :D

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: We're just getting started with Nadia's rehab,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: and there's still a long way to go,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: but at least there's hope.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Let's keep pushing

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: until the day Nadia competes in a track and field competition!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I'll be there with you every step of the way, helping out however I can!

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I'll help as much as I can as well.
I have to finish what I started, so I'm in.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Nadia is so lucky to

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: have such dependable people around her.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Thank you all, for everything you've done.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: There are still many hurdles to overcome until she's ready for a competition,

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: but together, I know we can do it!

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: We've got this!
Let's go!

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: :D
